subject: Request: permission to publish case study & use Skyline Systems branding
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skylinesystems.com>, Jason Hu <jason.hu@skylinesystems.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: permission to publish case study & use Skyline Systems branding

Hi Elena / Jason,

Thanks again for the customer calls last week — the product team and I appreciated the time and candid feedback. We put together a short draft case study that highlights the technical integration, the cost/latency improvements you saw, and the quote you provided.

Attached: skyline_case_draft_v1.docx (draft copy) and logo_request_form.pdf (for brand assets).

As part of our marketing process, we need:
- Formal permission to use Skyline Systems name and logo in a Redwood case study and landing page.
- Approval of the quote excerpt (we'll publish verbatim once approved).
- Any required trademark or attribution language you prefer.

Target publish window: week of Dec 15. If that timeline is a problem please tell us and we can move it.

Can your marketing or legal team review the attached and share any redlines? If easier, we're happy to take the draft into a brief (15–20 min) call to walk through edits.

Thanks — appreciate your help.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0183

Attachments: skyline_case_draft_v1.docx (docx), logo_request_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skylinesystems.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Hu <jason.hu@skylinesystems.com>, skylinesystems-legal@skylinesystems.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: permission to publish case study & use Skyline Systems branding

Hi Priyom — thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary.

I shared the draft with our comms and legal folks. A couple quick notes from marketing:
- Please use our full brand name "Skyline Systems" on first reference, then "Skyline" in the rest of the piece.
- We will provide a high-res horizontal logo (EPS/PNG), and our logo usage guidelines — attaching the guidelines now.
- For the quote, can you mark the excerpt in yellow so it's obvious which line we need to confirm?

From legal: we typically need to sign a short logo permission form (no surprises) and we cannot include exact ARR numbers in public materials — we can use percent improvement and relative terms instead.

I'm attaching: Skyline_logo_guidelines.pdf (brand & logo specs). I'll loop in skylinesystems-legal@skylinesystems.com for the formal permission. Expect an update from them by EOD Friday (Dec 4).

If you want to move faster, happy to do a quick call Wed or Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Product Marketing, Skyline Systems
elena.morris@skylinesystems.com

Attachment: Skyline_logo_guidelines.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: permission to publish case study & use Skyline Systems branding

Priyom — reviewed the draft and Elena's guidelines. I attached a redline with our recommended language. High level:

1) Trademark attribution: include the sentence "Skyline Systems is a registered trademark of Skyline Systems, Inc.; all rights reserved." in the footer.
2) Quote: publish the quote only after the customer sends an approved "approved_quote.txt" or signs the permission form.
3) Remove exact ARR/revenue figures; replace with relative improvements (e.g., "~35% reduction in latency" or ">20% cost per token savings").
4) 30-day takedown clause: include a clause that allows Skyline to request removal with 30 days' notice, which is standard and should be acceptable.

I've attached case_study_redline_v1.docx that shows the exact edits. Once the customer signs off (logo permission + approved quote) we can publish.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: case_study_redline_v1.docx

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@skylinesystems.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: skylinesystems-legal@skylinesystems.com, Jason Hu <jason.hu@skylinesystems.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: permission to publish case study & use Skyline Systems branding — APPROVED (signed)

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks for the patience — legal finished their review. We're good to publish with the redlines applied. Attached are two files: Skyline_logo_permission_signed.pdf (signed permission form) and approved_quote.txt (the verbatim quote we approve).

Conditions we agreed to:
- Include the trademark attribution line in the footer (as Laura recommended).
- Do not publish revenue numbers; use the relative improvement language.
- If Skyline requests removal, Redwood will remove the asset within 30 days of receiving notice.

Target publish date of Dec 16 works for us. Please send a final pre-publish link for one last quick check.

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Product Marketing, Skyline Systems
elena.morris@skylinesystems.com

Attachments: Skyline_logo_permission_signed.pdf (pdf), approved_quote.txt (txt)
